quote: We have so appreciated Rhian’s attentiveness and care

quote: Rhian has taught our family to use music throughout everyday life and it brings us so much joy

quote: Thank you for bringing more music into our everyday life. The songs we've learned through you have entertained, brought family connection and soothed us all in tricky moments.

quote: Thank you so much for your skill, enthusiasm and inclusivity! We have loved attending classes with you.

quote: We will treasure the time we’ve shared together in class with Rhian. Her energy, enthusiasm and warmth helped me personally to develop more playfulness and spontaneity in my parenting, and I think we are all better off for having had Rhian in our lives! Thank you!
